report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the required experience in the following areas: 5+ years of software development, 2+ years of Python-based backend development, asynchronous programming and performance-critical applications, AWS and microservices, machine learning, and algorithms development (e.g., collaborative filtering, similarity, clustering).

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
